en.headline: 61-year-old worker dies after being struck by vehicle at Sha Tin site
en.dek: The Labour Department is investigating after a female worker was run over by a grab lorry while washing vehicle tyres at a construction site entrance near Pok Hong Estate on Thursday.
body: A 61-year-old female worker died on Thursday morning after she was struck and run over by a grab lorry at a construction site on Sha Tin Road near Pok Hong Estate.

The Labour Department said the woman was washing vehicle tyres on the vehicular lane at the site entrance when the incident occurred at about 11am. She was certified dead at the scene. The Civil Engineering and Development Department said the worker was a contractor's staff member on the Trunk Road T4 project and expressed its condolences.

The Labour Department said it immediately began an on-site investigation and issued suspension notices to the contractors, stopping any work on the vehicular lane until suitable measures to remove the risks are in place. The department is examining the cause and the liability of duty holders.

Police arrested a 45-year-old driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death. The Labour Department reminded employers of the need to segregate workers from vehicles with barriers where possible and to provide reflective clothing. Work at the site has been suspended while investigations continue.

zh.headline: 沙田工地女工被抓斗貨車輾斃 勞工處展開調查
zh.dek: 一名61歲女工周四上午在沙田路近博康邨地盤出入口沖洗車胎時，被抓斗貨車輾過身亡，勞工處已發出暫時停工通知書。
body: 一名61歲女工周四上午在沙田路近博康邨的建築地盤內被抓斗貨車輾過，當場不治。
勞工處表示，事發時該名女工正在地盤出入口的行車路沖洗車輛輪胎，約上午11時發生意外。土木工程拓展署表示，死者為T4號主幹路工程承建商員工，署方對事件深表難過，並向家屬致以深切慰問。
勞工處發言人說，得知意外後已即時派員到場調查，並向有關承建商發出暫時停工通知書，停止在該地盤行車路上進行任何工作，直至確認已採取適當措施消除危害才可復工。署方正調查意外成因及持責者法律責任。
警方以涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人死亡拘捕一名45歲貨車司機。勞工處提醒僱主須以屏障分隔工人與車輛通道，並提供反光衣。現場工作已暫停，調查仍在進行。Correction: 修正中文用字錯誤。
